artifact_observations.reasoning: The text on the labels is nonsensical scribbles. It mimics the shape of handwriting or print but contains no legible characters, a classic AI generation artifact.

The red plastic lacks the subtle specular highlights, mold lines, or micro-scratches typical of real injection-molded plastic. It appears slightly too smooth and uniform, resembling a digital render rather than a photograph.

The center hubs of the spools lack clear mechanical detail (such as the D-shape or gear teeth needed for a player to grip them). They appear as vague dark circles without precise geometric definition.
